clues.text: Naboth owned a vineyard in this place, right next to the palace of King Ahab.
Elijah told King Ahab that the dogs would devour Jezebel by the wall of this city.
As heavy rain fell, Elijah tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab's chariot all the way here.
Before Gideon blew the ram's horn, the Midianites and Amalekites crossed the Jordan and camped in this valley.
While the Philistines gathered their forces at Aphek, Israel's army camped by the spring at this place.
Wounded by the Arameans at Ramah, King Joram son of Ahab came back to this city to recover.
The LORD told Hosea to give this name to his first son by Gomer, as a warning to the house of Jehu.
